skills.name: xc8-build

The script stays generic by defaulting to SCMCU project-file metadata, while still allowing explicit overrides for chip, source files, and image prefix when an agent or user needs to drive a custom build. Keep artifacts under build/xc8/<build-name>/ and inspect cmscerr.err plus map output for ROM/RAM usage, warnings, and function sizes. skills.name: daplink
skills.description: Flash, verify and debug ARM Cortex-M firmware through DAPLink/CMSIS-DAP probes. Provides 47 subcommands for probe/target discovery, CMSIS-Packs, flashing, hardware and flash breakpoints, conditional breakpoints with on-hit scripts, DWARF CFI backtraces, C expression evaluation, SVD peripherals, RTOS threads, RTT, SWO/ITM, semihosting, multicore, DWT cycle counting, and a rule-based HardFault analyser with self-contained HTML reports. Supports both pyOCD and probe-rs backends with automatic chip-name routing. On WSL it auto-detects Windows-side probes through usbipd and can attach them to the distro. Use when the user asks to flash or erase a board, attach a debugger, inspect registers/memory, set breakpoints, capture RTT/SWO output, or diagnose a crash/HardFault.
skills.short_description: Flash/debug Cortex-M over DAPLink with fault root-cause reports (WSL-aware)

interface.short_description: Flash/debug Cortex-M over DAPLink with fault root-cause reports (WSL-aware)
interface.default_prompt: Use $daplink to flash or debug a Cortex-M target, inspect registers and memory, set conditional breakpoints, capture RTT/SWO, or diagnose a HardFault with a root-cause report.
